overview: Katta Gardens is a terraced botanical district designed for civic leisure, arcane horticulture, and environmental harmony.
history: Established early in the Loyalist settlement to provide a place of rest and civic beauty.
Arcane horticulturists introduced magically‑enhanced flora to stabilize local resonance.
The gardens became a favored meeting place for citizens and Senate envoys.
Terraced walkways were added to connect the gardens with upper civic districts.
hooks: A rare arcane bloom begins emitting unstable magical pulses.
Garden wardens report unusual movement among the flora.
A Senate envoy requests assistance preparing the gardens for a diplomatic event.
A horticulturist goes missing near the Resonance Grove.
